newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: RESEARCH ALERT - Credit Lyonnais starts Electricidad.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Credit Lyonnais starts Electricidad.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais said it started Venezuelan electric utility Electricidad de Caracas with a buy rating.

"EDC is a likely participant in future electric utility privatizations, as it is at least seven times the sum of the remaining private companies in the electricity sector," Credit Lyonnais said in a research report.
Electricidad, the benchmark stock on the Caracas Stock Exchange has a healthy balance sheet and strong cash generation, implying net debt of little more than $70 million in 1997, the report said.
"We believe that an appropriate value of the shares is $1.55, representing an upside of 60 percent on a 12-month perspective," it added.
Electricidad shares were up 23.00 bolivars from Tuesday's close at 503.00 bolivars ($1.07) at about 1115 EDT (1515 GMT).
